verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI assistant platform, but the evidence pack never documents user-defined rules, triggers, or event-driven actions. Related items describe other things: the Assistant scheduling appointments, Computer launching a browser automatically during a task, and automatic model failover. None of these is a user-configurable event-to-action rule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
